It seems the tool parsing is strict. Need to ensure JSON is valid and no extra spaces? The previous attempts maybe had stray quotes. Let's craft minimal.

We need:

<thought>Validate route</thought>
<action>verify_route</action>
<action_input>{"route":"{\"type\":\"mol\",\"smiles\":\"[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]\",\"children\":[{\"type\":\"reaction\",\"template_id\":\"1209837\",\"children\":[{\"type\":\"mol\",\"smiles\":\"C=C(C)C(=O)O[C@@]1(C(F)(F)F)CCC[C@H]1C(=C)c1ccccc1\"}]}]}"}"</action_input>

But note the outer JSON must not have trailing quote after the string. The string ends with }". Actually we need to close the outer string with a double quote, then close the outer JSON object. So:

{"route":"{\"type\":\"mol\",\"smiles\":\"...\",\"children\":[...]}"} 

No extra quote after. So the action_input should be that.

Let's produce exactly.
